data.event_catalog: Ágústsdóttir et al. (2019), Data Set S1, https://doi.org/10.1029/2018JB016010
data.sample: 2014-08-23 12:00:29.86 to 13:48:56.81 UTC, first 100 consecutive events after noon. 11 available stations, 3300 SAC cuts.
data.phase_markers: SAC A/T0 calculated using homogeneous 6.0/3.5 km/s P/S speeds.

illustrations.holuhraun_landsat.jpg: NASA Earth Observatory / Jesse Allen, Landsat 8 data from USGS. Holuhraun lava field, 6 September 2014, false colour. https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/roiling-flows-on-holuhraun-lava-field-84316/
illustrations.Iceland report screenshots: The laboratory and report figures show the real 100-event run: its 22 station/phase matrices, quality summary, cycle-closure plots, filter audit and accepted waveform examples. The filter-response calibration uses test sinusoids; the waveform spectra use Iceland recordings.
illustrations.Waveforms and measurements: The methods figures use the Iceland100 waveforms, configuration and exported correlations. Refer to build instructions, individual slide notes and linked Julia source.
illustrations.Competing peaks and threshold comparison: KVER P pair 13/27 is shown in the 4–8 Hz band. P station counts compare two coefficient thresholds applied to the accepted reference rows; see lag_figure.py and threshold_figure.py.
